title: Unicycle Kinematic Model
text: Compute vehicle motion using unicycle kinematic model, 3 inputs, 2 outputs; {Vehicle inputs} sets the type of speed and directional inputs for vehicle Vehicle Speed & Heading Angular, {Wheel radius}, {Wheel speed range} sets the minimum and Maximum vehicle speeds, {Initial state} sets the distance between front and rear axles and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: dϕ/dt
ports.summary: Angular velocity of wheel numeric scalar

ports.name: stateDot
ports.summary: Derivatives of state output three-element vector

params.name: Vehicle inputs
params.values: Type of speed and directional inputs for vehicle Vehicle Speed & Heading Angular Velocity (default) | Wheel Speed & Heading Angular Velocity

params.name: Wheel radius
params.values: Wheel radius of vehicle 0.1 (default) | positive numeric scalar

params.name: Wheel speed range
params.values: Minimum and Maximum vehicle speeds [-Inf Inf] (default) | two-element vector

params.name: Initial state
params.values: Distance between front and rear axles [0;0;0] (default) | three-element vector

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
